title: Pain Reassessment from Pulse Waveforms with Language Model Explanations
abstract: arXiv:2611.29128v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Routine photoplethysmography (PPG) offers a continuous physiological signal for pain reassessment between self-reports. Whether prior recordings provide an individualized physiological reference beyond care-process timing remains unresolved. Across 52,082 report-linked assessments from 21,514 patients in MIMIC-III critical care and MC-MED emergency care, we evaluate a workflow that pairs longitudinal PPG representations with local evidence-linked language interpretation. Among 27 methods, source-selected full-history models achieved average precision of 0.824 from critical to emergency care and 0.822 in reverse. Removing historical pulse-run representations while retaining reassessment availability and elapsed time lowered critical-to-emergency four-hour within-patient concordance from 0.718 to 0.534. This comparison supports the contribution of prior pulse-run representations to within-patient ordering beyond timing cues. Across 2,905 t

translated_title: 基于脉搏波形与语言模型解释的疼痛再评估
translated_abstract: 常规光电容积脉搏波描记法（PPG）为两次自我报告之间的疼痛再评估提供了连续的生理信号。既往记录能否在护理流程时间信息之外提供个性化的生理参考，这一问题尚待解决。我们在MIMIC-III重症监护和MC-MED急诊护理中21,514名患者的52,082次与报告关联的评估上，评估了一种将纵向PPG表征与本地证据关联的语言解释相结合的工作流程。在27种方法中，经源选择的完整历史模型在从重症监护到急诊护理的迁移中达到0.824的平均精度，反向迁移为0.822。在保留再评估可用性与经过时间的同时移除历史脉搏记录表征后，重症监护到急诊护理的四小时患者内一致性从0.718降至0.534。该对比支持了既往脉搏记录表征在时间线索之外对患者内疼痛排序的贡献。（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究提出一种融合纵向脉搏波形表征与语言模型解释的疼痛再评估工作流程，并证明患者既往脉搏记录在护理时间信息之外对个性化的患者内疼痛排序具有关键贡献。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a pain reassessment workflow that pairs longitudinal pulse waveform (PPG) representations with language model explanations, demonstrating that patients' prior pulse recordings contribute to individualized within-patient pain ordering beyond care-process timing cues.
